title: Gradient-Guided Reward Optimization for Inference-time Alignment
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical method (GGRO) for aligning Large Language Models at inference time using reward model gradients. While it evaluates models on 'safety' benchmarks that include categories like 'Hate', the work is centered on algorithmic optimization and general alignment (helpfulness, reasoning, safety) rather than specifically benchmarking religion, religious values, morals, or philosophical ethical frameworks.
